import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Scatter plot: Sepal length vs Sepal width
scatter1 = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['sepal_length'], df['sepal_width'], 
                              c=pd.factorize(df['species'])[0], cmap='viridis', 
                              alpha=0.8, s=60)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Scatter plot: Petal length vs Petal width
scatter2 = axes[0, 1].scatter(df['petal_length'], df['petal_width'], 
                              c=pd.factorize(df['species'])[0], cmap='plasma', 
                              alpha=0.8, s=60)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Box plot: Sepal measurements by species
df_melted_sepal = df.melt(id_vars=['species'], 
                          value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width'], 
                          var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
sns.boxplot(x='species', y='value', hue='measurement', data=df_melted_sepal, 
            ax=axes[1, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sepal Measurements Distribution by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Measurement', fontsize=10)

# Box plot: Petal measurements by species
df_melted_petal = df.melt(id_vars=['species'], 
                          value_vars=['petal_length', 'petal_width'], 
                          var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
sns.boxplot(x='species', y='value', hue='measurement', data=df_melted_petal, 
            ax=axes[1, 1], palette='Set3')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Petal Measurements Distribution by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Measurement', fontsize=10)

# Create custom legend for scatter plots
species_names = df['species'].unique()
colors1 = plt.cm.viridis([0, 0.5, 1.0])
colors2 = plt.cm.plasma([0, 0.5, 1.0])

legend_elements1 = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', 
                              markerfacecolor=colors1[i], markersize=10, 
                              label=species_names[i]) for i in range(len(species_names))]
legend_elements2 = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', 
                              markerfacecolor=colors2[i], markersize=10, 
                              label=species_names[i]) for i in range(len(species_names))]

axes[0, 0].legend(handles=legend_elements1, title='Species', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].legend(handles=legend_elements2, title='Species', fontsize=10)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Iris Dataset Analysis: Flower Measurements by Species', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
